description: The bar chart titled "Evaluation Based on Direct" compares the accuracy of different evaluation methods for language models. The vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, while the horizontal axis lists three evaluation methods: MCQ Eval, RMU with Enhanced GCG, and Generation Eval. The MCQ Eval method has an accuracy of 0.644, RMU with Enhanced GCG has an accuracy of 0.539, and Generation Eval has an accuracy of 0.263. The bars are color-coded, with MCQ Eval in red, RMU with Enhanced GCG in green, and Generation Eval in yellow. The chart does not indicate any sorting or emphasis on specific bars.
